title: Alpha 10 Hz | Calm Awareness, Quiet the Noise
description:
Calm awareness, quiet the noise.

Alpha sits at roughly 8 to 13 Hz and shows up when you are awake but settled, eyes closed, attention soft rather than narrow. Hans Berger first recorded it a century ago. Binaural beats in this band present a phantom difference tone that the auditory brainstem tracks, and the cortex tends to follow, which is why alpha is associated with calm alertness rather than drowsiness.

This session: 200 Hz in the left ear, 210.0 Hz in the right ear, so the beat lands at 10.0 Hz. Length 60 seconds.

Headphones are required, since the two ears have to hear two different tones for the phantom beat to exist. Listen at a comfortable volume.

Cognistration is an exploration tool, not a medical device, and nothing here is a treatment for any condition. If you have a seizure disorder, tinnitus, or a hearing concern, talk to a clinician before experimenting with tones.
